AGI is a direction. Not a claim.

At UzLeeder, AGI names our technology and product direction: intelligent, connected business systems under explicit human control. We have not built artificial general intelligence, and this page does not claim it. Every section says clearly what is implemented, what is vision, and what is still research.

Vision

Where we are heading

A business should be able to run on systems that understand its work: requests arrive in one place, routine steps happen automatically, and the people in charge see everything and decide.

  • Software carries the routine work; decisions stay with people.
  • One connected system instead of many disconnected tools.
  • AI is added where it is reliable and tested — not for decoration.
Currently implemented

The current system

This is the operating chain UzLeeder has built for itself. The same approach is what we build for clients.

Website brief/@uzleeder_services_bot→ Request→Workspace→ Project→Content→Telegram channels
  • Project briefs from this website are validated on the server and stored as requests before success is shown.
  • @uzleeder_services_bot collects service, description, contact and an optional file. It is code-powered — there is no AI inside it.
  • The private Workspace turns requests into clients and projects, with tasks, versioned files and an activity log of real events only.
  • Content Studio publishes to our Telegram channels through the Telegram Bot API and records each channel's own result — sent, failed or not sent.
Currently implemented

Currently implemented

Architecture

  • Static, multilingual front end (EN · UZ · RU · FA · AR) with a serverless API on Vercel.
  • Private storage on Vercel Blob; Workspace files are never served publicly.
  • Every Workspace and admin action is authenticated and checked on the server. Tokens and credentials never reach the browser.
  • External services — Telegram, GitHub, Vercel, YouTube — are connected only where credentials are configured. Otherwise the Workspace shows "Integration required".
Currently implemented

How it is developed

We build with AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. Architecture, review, security, testing and the final decision stay human-owned — Max is responsible for what ships.

Limitations, stated plainly:

  • This is not general intelligence, and nothing here makes decisions on its own.
  • AI output can be wrong; critical answers keep a person in the loop.
  • Publishing and deployments are reported only after the external service confirms the result.
